description: Capture a UAV/drone observation for civil safety monitoring, military situational awareness, or intelligence collection. Includes drone platform details, sighting location, observed behavior, and optional attribution.
name: UAV observation

structure.help: Capture the minimum context required to route the event to the right operational team.
structure.label: Observation overview

structure.help: Choose the operational framing for this report. Suggested values: `civil`, `military`, `intelligence`.
structure.label: Observation context

structure.help: When the UAV activity was observed. Use UTC when possible (for example `2026-04-26T14:20:00Z`).
structure.label: Date observed

structure.help: One- or two-sentence snapshot: what was observed, where, and why it matters.
structure.label: Short summary

structure.help: UAV platform details using the dedicated MISP `uav` object template.
structure.label: UAV platform

structure.help: Populate the most reliable platform identifiers first (manufacturer, model, serial number). Add mission clues when known.
structure.label: Observed UAV

relations.help_override: Unique serial if recovered from telemetry, remote-ID feed, or physical access.
Useful when the same model has sub-variants with different capabilities.
Mission class from observation (for example surveillance, delivery, mapping, attack).
Assessment of mission intent when available (for example hostile, neutral, unknown).
Any official registration identifier observed in the field.
Attach GPX/KML or equivalent path evidence when available.
Attach photo(s) of the observed UAV.
Free-form analyst note specific to the UAV object.

structure.help: Where the UAV activity was observed.
structure.label: Observation location

structure.help: Use precise coordinates when available; otherwise city/region/country is sufficient.
structure.label: Sighting geolocation

relations.help_override: Altitude in meters if known from telemetry or sensor fusion.
Human-readable location context (for example near critical infrastructure, border crossing, event venue).

structure.comment: Observed UAV linked to the location where it was sighted

structure.help: Additional indicators and references collected during the observation.
structure.label: Indicators and references

structure.help: Controller or telemetry endpoint observed during interception, RF analysis, or network capture.
structure.label: Control endpoint URL

structure.help: Case reference, external advisory, NOTAM, or intelligence report URL.
structure.label: Reference URL

structure.help: TLP, source reliability, and optional attribution tags/clusters.
structure.label: Classification and attribution

structure.help: Pick one TLP value for sharing constraints.
structure.label: TLP

structure.help: Optional intelligence confidence coding for source reliability and information credibility.
structure.label: Admiralty scale

structure.help: Optional. Use when there is grounded evidence for actor attribution.
structure.label: Associated threat actor

structure.help: Optional. Associate the event with a country cluster when this is operationally relevant and supported.
structure.label: Associated country

structure.content: **Operational note:** use this template for both safety observations and hostile-UAV reporting. If evidence is weak, leave optional attribution fields blank and rely on factual UAV/object/location data first.
